events.name: DOSE_ADDED
events.description: Fires after every dose increase — from the small/large add buttons or an auto-drip tick — with the accumulated dose and its classified band. A composed sibling trait transitions on it to recompute a domain-specific response (e.g. a chemistry pH curve) and repaint the scene it owns. A harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: dose added, increment, add, drip, titrant added, quantity added

events.name: DOSE_RESET
events.description: Fires on Reset after the dose, band, and done flag re-zero. A composed sibling trait reseeds its own domain state from config on it. A harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.name: DOSER_UPDATED
events.description: Fires on INIT/MODE_SELECTED/auto-drip toggle with the transport-level state — running flag, dose, current band, done — so a composed sibling trait can repaint its own shell. A harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto Drip
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, INIT/MODE_SELECTED/Reset start the drip clock adding a small increment each interval; toggle live with the Auto-dose/Pause button.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bands
overridableConfigKeys.description: Ordered ascending roster of dose bands/zones — each carries the dose upper bound it covers, a label, a color, and whether crossing into it is terminal (irreversible; sets done true until Reset). The accumulated dose is classified into the first band whose upperBound it does not exceed, falling through to the last band beyond all bounds.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: zone, band, threshold, region, stage, phase, tier

overridableConfigKeys.label: Capacity
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maximum total dose the source can deliver; the source vessel drains to empty and additions clamp once accumulated dose reaches this cap.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drip Interval (ms)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Milliseconds of running clock per auto-drip increment — the 32ms base tick accumulates elapsed time and adds a small step each time this interval elapses.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dose History
overridableConfigKeys.description: Maximum points kept in the dose-history trace; older points drop off once exceeded.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Quantity Label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label used for the accumulated-quantity readout and in the narration line.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reservoir Label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label for the vessel that fills as dose accumulates.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: reservoir, beaker, tank, container, receiving vessel

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show Canvas
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true (the default, standalone use) the instrument renders its own reservoir/source canvas and narration below the control strip. Set false when a domain sibling trait composes this atom via @rebindable and owns the accurate scene render itself — then only the control strip (add/drip/reset buttons) embeds via @trait.<name>, avoiding a duplicate canvas.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Source Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fill color for the source vessel.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Source Label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label for the vessel that drains as dose is delivered from it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Large Step
overridableConfigKeys.description: Quantity added per press of the coarse add button.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Small Step
overridableConfigKeys.description: Quantity added per press of the fine add button, and per auto-drip tick — for precise control near a band boundary.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Unit
overridableConfigKeys.description: Unit suffix appended to the step-size button labels (e.g. "mL", "mg", "units"); empty means no unit shown.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Zone Readout Label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Label used for the current-band readout row.
